title: APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting (first ever in Hong Kong) — day 1 of 2
source: NEWS: Hong Kong's government announced on 2025-12-12 (news.gov.hk and thestandard.com.hk, both fetched direct 2026-10-19) that Hong Kong hosts its first APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting in October 2026, but neither fetched page gives days. The Oct 20-21 days are repeated by SCMP in three October-2026 pieces (the Bessent-may-skip report, 'John Lee promises high-quality experience', 'Paul Chan highlights 4 priorities') as read through search summaries on 2026-10-19 — Convention and Exhibition Centre, Wan Chai, ~500 guests from 21 economies — but the SCMP pages 403'd to the fetcher and apec.org's annual-ministerial index does not list 2026, so no APEC or HKSAR primary naming the days was read. Filed estimate on that basis. Checked 2026-10-19
notes: Discovered during the apec-leaders-shenzhen-2026-11-18 pulse (2026-10-19); initial research 2026-10-19 (D-1). Day 1 of a two-day window per house convention. The only market-relevant question is US representation: SCMP (Oct 2026) reports Bessent may skip it, with Under Secretary for International Affairs Erin Browne the leading candidate to lead the US delegation, saving his China channel for a Shenzhen round with He Lifeng ahead of Trump's November visit. The same skip pattern already played out at the 10/15 G20 finance ministerial in Bangkok (no price effect). Estimate widens caution only; no tracked symbol is keyed to it.
